headline: An Island of Cloud Trails and Lava Pools
editorial_intent: Replace the prohibited 012-madeira-cloud-trails-lava-pools moving-zoom slideshow with a manually swipeable, source-verified 4:5 original-photo carousel, making the locations clear, distinct and shareable.
reader_scenario: A reader who wants to pause and swipe through extraordinary, geographically identified and believable travel images.
share_reason: A concise real-photo collection of varied striking locations that travellers can save and explore at their own pace without an artificial photo-video edit.
slide_count_rationale: 8 distinct authentic original photographs, 1 scenic branded final slide created from the same licensed images. Extra views chosen for different scenes and reader value.
caption:
One Portuguese island. Eight landscapes that hardly look like they belong together. 🌿

📍 Pico do Arieiro — mountain paths weave high above the clouds.
📍 Fanal Forest — twisted ancient laurel trees disappear into the mist.
📍 Santana — see traditional colourful thatched-roof cottages.
📍 Seixal — black sand sits beneath the lush north-coast cliffs.
📍 Risco Waterfall — water drops into deep green forest.
📍 Porto Moniz — swim in natural pools bordered by volcanic rock.
📍 Ribeira da Janela — see sea stacks rise out of a rugged Atlantic shore.
📍 Ponta de São Lourenço — follow a sunrise trail on Madeira's wild eastern headland.

Which scene would you go to first?

Photos: Samielle Støyl, Colin Watts, Julia Schuwer, Daniel J. Schwarz & Mick Kirchman, Markus Kammermann, Reinaldo Photography / Unsplash.
